/**
 * System Monitor Frame Parser
 *
 * Parses pipe-delimited KEY=value frames into a persistent value array.
 * Keys absent from a frame retain their previous value, so the static
 * header fields (OS, CPU model, etc.) remain populated after the first
 * frame even as live metric frames keep updating the rest.
 *
 * Index layout (0-based internal, 1-based in .ssproj):
 *   0-6   OS HOSTNAME CPU_MODEL CPU_CORES CPU_THREADS RAM_TOTAL DISK_TOTAL
 *   7     CPU_USAGE      12  SWAP_USED      17  CORE0
 *   8     RAM_USAGE      13  CPU_TEMP       18  CORE1 ... 48 CORE31
 *   9     RAM_USED       14  NET_SENT       49  PROC0
 *   10    DISK_USAGE     15  NET_RECV       50  PROC1 ... 58 PROC9
 *   11    DISK_USED      16  PROCESSES
 *
 * @param frame  Raw frame string (frameStart already stripped).
 * @returns Array of 59 persistent values.
 */

var _numItems = 59;
var _map = {
  "OS": 0,
  "HOSTNAME": 1,
  "CPU_MODEL": 2,
  "CPU_CORES": 3,
  "CPU_THREADS": 4,
  "RAM_TOTAL": 5,
  "DISK_TOTAL": 6,
  "CPU_USAGE": 7,
  "RAM_USAGE": 8,
  "RAM_USED": 9,
  "DISK_USAGE": 10,
  "DISK_USED": 11,
  "CPU_TEMP": 12,
  "SWAP_USED": 13,
  "NET_SENT": 14,
  "NET_RECV": 15,
  "PROCESSES": 16,
  "CORE0": 17,
  "CORE1": 18,
  "CORE2": 19,
  "CORE3": 20,
  "CORE4": 21,
  "CORE5": 22,
  "CORE6": 23,
  "CORE7": 24,
  "CORE8": 25,
  "CORE9": 26,
  "CORE10": 27,
  "CORE11": 28,
  "CORE12": 29,
  "CORE13": 30,
  "CORE14": 31,
  "CORE15": 32,
  "CORE16": 33,
  "CORE17": 34,
  "CORE18": 35,
  "CORE19": 36,
  "CORE20": 37,
  "CORE21": 38,
  "CORE22": 39,
  "CORE23": 40,
  "CORE24": 41,
  "CORE25": 42,
  "CORE26": 43,
  "CORE27": 44,
  "CORE28": 45,
  "CORE29": 46,
  "CORE30": 47,
  "CORE31": 48,
  "PROC0": 49,
  "PROC1": 50,
  "PROC2": 51,
  "PROC3": 52,
  "PROC4": 53,
  "PROC5": 54,
  "PROC6": 55,
  "PROC7": 56,
  "PROC8": 57,
  "PROC9": 58
};

var _vals = new Array(_numItems).fill('');

function parse(frame) {
  if (frame.length === 0)
    return _vals;

  var pairs = frame.split('|');
  for (var i = 0; i < pairs.length; i++) {
    var eq = pairs[i].indexOf('=');
    if (eq < 0)
      continue;
      
    var key = pairs[i].substring(0, eq).trim();
    var val = pairs[i].substring(eq + 1).trim();
    if (_map.hasOwnProperty(key))
      _vals[_map[key]] = val;
  }

  return _vals;
}
